newsitem.title: ESTONIA: BALTIKA TO MAKE SHARE ISSUE, GET LISTING.
newsitem.headline: BALTIKA TO MAKE SHARE ISSUE, GET LISTING.

text.p: Baltika, a clothing manufacturer and retailer, will organise an issue of 18.5 million kroons of shares and plans a stock market listing in May or June.
Baltika's said in a statement that Hansainvest will assist in taking Baltika to the market with the issue, which will happen in April. The move to the bourse is set for May or June.
The share issue was decided by the company's shareholder meeting held on Tuesday.
The company will seek a listing on the free market and after that on the main list, Baltika's general manager Meelis Miilder said in the statement.

Baltika group's total turnover in 1996 was over 300 million kroons. Net profit in 1996 was 13.4 million kroons and its net turnover was 188.4 million kroons, a growth of 32.3 percent, the company added.
The Baltic Republics Fund owns 20 percent of the company's existing stock, the statement added.
